I am a researcher working on wireless communications and networking, with a focus on task-oriented semantic communication, integrated sensing and communication, Age of Information, NOMA, vehicular networks, and learning-based resource allocation.

My research aims to design communication-efficient, freshness-aware, and task-aware wireless systems for emerging 6G applications, where communication decisions are optimized according to the timeliness and utility of downstream tasks.
:::
:::

## Research interests

- Task-oriented and semantic communications
- Integrated sensing, communication, and computation for 6G systems
- Age of Information and information freshness
- NOMA, multicast/unicast coexistence, and resource allocation
- Vehicular networks, C-V2X, and edge intelligence
- Learning-based optimization for wireless networks

## Recent focus

My recent work studies how wireless systems can jointly account for communication reliability, sensing requirements, computational constraints, and task deadlines. Instead of optimizing only throughput or latency, I am interested in freshness-aware and task-aware metrics that better capture the value of delivered information.
